theme: Kể về dự án đáng nhớ

vocab.meaning_vi: làm từ đầu, từ con số không
vocab.example: We built the internal reporting tool from scratch in four months.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi xây công cụ báo cáo nội bộ từ đầu trong bốn tháng.

vocab.meaning_vi: khởi động, bắt đầu (một dự án)
vocab.example: I helped kick off the project by writing the first requirement list.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi giúp khởi động dự án bằng việc viết danh sách yêu cầu đầu tiên.

vocab.example: During the pilot phase, only two departments used the new system.
vocab.example_vi: Trong giai đoạn thí điểm, chỉ hai phòng ban dùng hệ thống mới.

vocab.example: I collected user feedback every Friday and shared it with the developers.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi thu thập phản hồi của người dùng mỗi thứ Sáu và chia sẻ cho các lập trình viên.

vocab.example: After the test, we decided to roll out the tool to all offices.
vocab.example_vi: Sau đợt thử nghiệm, chúng tôi quyết định triển khai công cụ ra toàn bộ văn phòng.

vocab.example: The system went live in June without any serious problem.
vocab.example_vi: Hệ thống chính thức chạy thật vào tháng Sáu mà không gặp vấn đề nghiêm trọng nào.

vocab.meaning_vi: quá trình học để thành thạo (thường vất vả lúc đầu)
vocab.example: The learning curve was steep because I had never managed a budget before.
vocab.example_vi: Quá trình học khá vất vả vì trước đó tôi chưa từng quản lý ngân sách.

vocab.example: We finished two weeks ahead of schedule and still stayed inside the budget.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi hoàn thành sớm hơn kế hoạch hai tuần mà vẫn nằm trong ngân sách.

listening.title: Tell me about a project you are proud of

lines.speaker: Lan (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: Nam, could you walk me through a project you are really proud of?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Certainly. Last year my company had no way to track customer requests.

lines.speaker: Lan (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: So what exactly was your role in solving that?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: I was asked to build a simple tracking tool from scratch with two colleagues.

lines.speaker: Lan (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: How did you kick off the work with such a small team?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: I interviewed eight staff members first, then wrote a short list of must-have features.

lines.speaker: Lan (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: Did you release everything to the whole company at once?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: No. We ran a pilot phase with one team and collected user feedback weekly.

lines.speaker: Lan (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: That sounds careful. What was the hardest part for you personally?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: The learning curve, honestly. I had never planned a rollout for non-technical users.

lines.speaker: Lan (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: And what was the final result?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: We went live in June, two weeks ahead of schedule, and response time dropped by half.

questions.q: What problem did Nam's company have?
options: No way to track customer requests

questions.q: What did Nam do before writing the feature list?
What did Nam find the hardest?
options: The learning curve of planning a rollout

shadowing: We built the reporting tool from scratch in only three months last year.
My task was to lead the pilot phase and collect early user feedback.
I ran daily check-ins so the team could kick off each week clearly.
We went live in June, two weeks ahead of the original schedule.
The learning curve was steep, but support tickets dropped by forty percent.
